brand_photography.philosophy: Photography is brand language, not decoration. Must communicate: PREMIUM, HUMAN, WARM, EDITORIAL, AUTHENTIC, REFINED, ASPIRATIONAL, QUIET. Avoids: generic stock, overly commercial, artificial beauty, cyberpunk, neon, excessive retouching, clinical aesthetics, generic fitness/barbershop advertising.
brand_photography.one_language: Single GlowApp photographic language across all expressions. Women/Men/AURA/Concierge are expressions of one brand, not separate visual brands.

female_muse.definition: Previously approved female model constitutes the official female muse for Phase 1.
female_muse.expression: Modern femininity + quiet luxury. Not pink beauty app, not overly glamorous stock beauty.
female_muse.lighting: Soft premium depth. Key light: large diffuse source at 45 deg. Fill: warm reflector. Temperature: 5200K-5600K. Shadow: soft, graduated. Skin rendering: natural texture preserved.
female_muse.composition: Editorial portraiture. Negative space for text/UI. Camera distance: medium (waist-up) to close (shoulders-up). Crop: intentional, never accidental face/eye/hands cuts.
female_muse.wardrobe: Neutral warm tones: cream, sand, warm white, soft terracotta, muted rose. Natural fibers: silk, linen, cashmere. Minimal jewelry - editorial, not accessorized.
female_muse.background: Warm neutral (cream/sand), light editorial, or environmental (spa/salon context). Never solid white, never solid black.
female_muse.skin_treatment: Natural texture preserved. No plastic skin. No aggressive smoothing. No distorted features. Light retouching only: blemish reduction, tone evening.
female_muse.hair: Natural movement. Soft waves, loose updos, or natural texture. No lacquered styles.
female_muse.makeup: Skin-first. Dewy finish. Subtle definition. Rose/champagne tones aligning with S1 Women palette.
female_muse.pose: Relaxed, aware, present. Not performative. Weight shift, natural hand placement, genuine eye contact or contemplative gaze.
female_muse.negative_space: Minimum 30% frame for text-safe zones in hero compositions.
prohibited: Solid white or black backgrounds as default

male_muse.definition: Previously approved male model constitutes the official male muse for Phase 1.
male_muse.characteristics: Attractive, Arabic/Middle Eastern appearance, beard, sophistication, premium grooming, editorial presence. Age 30-35.
male_muse.expression: Quiet masculine luxury. Not black everything, not aggressive macho, not generic barbershop, not sports advertising, not cyberpunk men.
male_muse.beard: Full, groomed, shaped - not wild, not stubble. Defined edges, healthy sheen. Color: natural dark with warm undertones.
male_muse.grooming: Immaculate skin prep. Subtle beard oil sheen. Neat hairline. Manicured hands (visible in detail shots).
male_muse.wardrobe: Tailored neutrals: warm charcoal, deep taupe, sand, cream, olive. Textures: wool, cashmere, cotton, leather. Collared shirts, unstructured jackets, knitwear. No logos.
male_muse.lighting: Structured but soft. Key: slightly harder than Women (more definition), fill: warm. Rembrandt or split lighting acceptable for structure. Temperature: 5000K-5400K. Shadows: defined but graduated. Highlights: controlled on skin/beard.
male_muse.background: Dark neutral (graphite/obsidian), warm neutral (taupe/sand), editorial environmental (barbershop/lounge context). Never solid black as brand background.
male_muse.pose: Grounded, confident, at ease. Shoulders relaxed. Hands: pockets, resting on surface, or natural gesture. Gaze: direct or slightly off-camera contemplative.
male_muse.composition: Stronger structure. More negative space on dark backgrounds. Camera distance: medium to close. Crop: intentional, respects beard/hands/face.
male_muse.skin_treatment: Natural texture. Visible pores, subtle beard texture. No smoothing. Warm undertones rendered faithfully.
prohibited: Solid black backgrounds as brand default
Generic barbershop tropes (striped poles, vintage chairs as decor)

women_system.expression: Softer visual expression. Beauty, elegance, ritual, skin/hair focus. Warm editorial palette (Rose Gold, Champagne, Warm Brown).
women_system.mood: Intimate, ritualistic, sensory. Moments of self-care: applying serum, brushing hair, contemplative pause.

men_system.expression: Stronger structure. Grooming, tailored styling, restrained masculinity. Warm neutral palette (Champagne, Warm White, Copper, Warm Stone, Taupe).
men_system.mood: Precise, confident, cared-for. Moments of grooming ritual: beard oil, scalp massage, fragrance selection, tailored fitting.
differentiators: Cooler color temperature bias (but warm neutrals)

aura_system.principle: AURA does NOT use robots, brains, chips, circuits, cyberpunk, neon, generic AI imagery.
aura_system.language: LIGHT, PERCEPTION, TRANSFORMATION, INTELLIGENCE, HUMAN CONTEXT, ABSTRACT ORGANIC FORMS.

use_photography: AURA Welcome: human context (model experiencing transformation)
Results revelation: model seeing their analysis
Concierge AURA: human advisor + subtle light geometry

visual_vocabulary: Concentric circles, fine geometry, points, sparkles - perception/intelligence
Aura Teal (#164C46) as accent only, never flood
Warm white/cream as base, not dark mode
prohibited: AURA visual on every screen - only when intelligence is relevant

concierge_system.principle: PERSONAL, HUMAN, PREMIUM, ATTENTIVE. Not call center, not corporate stock, not generic customer service.
appropriate_imagery: Personal service: concierge attendant with tablet, warm lighting
Consultation: two people in conversation, respectful distance
Hospitality: drink service, towel, door held open
Premium attention: detail shots of hands arranging, preparing
Environments: lounge, private room, spa reception - warm, quiet
concierge_system.mood: Anticipatory service. The feeling of being known and cared for before asking.
concierge_system.models: Real staff or official muses in concierge role. Not generic 'customer service rep' stock.
concierge_system.lighting: Warm, intimate. Golden hour or warm tungsten practical. Low contrast, inviting.

beauty_domains.principle: ONE GLOWAPP PHOTOGRAPHIC LANGUAGE. Not eight different visual styles.

SKINCARE.subject: Skin texture, product absorption, ritual application
SKINCARE.lighting: Soft window light, slight backlight for glow
SKINCARE.composition: Detail + context. Hands applying. Negative space for ingredient callouts.
SKINCARE.crop: Macro to medium. 4:5 or 1:1 for cards.

HAIR.subject: Hair movement, scalp health, styling result
HAIR.lighting: Rim light for separation, soft fill
HAIR.composition: Movement captured. Environmental salon context optional.

NAILS.subject: Nail art, hand care, color on skin tone
NAILS.lighting: Flat soft light for color accuracy
NAILS.color_relation: Full S1 Women palette - nails showcase color
NAILS.composition: Hand as compositional element. Clean background.

MAKEUP.subject: Application, finish, skin-like wear
MAKEUP.mood: Enhancement, not mask. Real skin visible.
MAKEUP.lighting: Beauty dish or large softbox. Catchlights in eyes.

FRAGRANCE.subject: Bottle as object, aura of scent, ritual of application
FRAGRANCE.composition: Hero bottle with negative space. Environmental mood.

BODY.subject: Skin texture, massage, product on body

SPA.subject: Environment, ritual, water, stone, steam
SPA.color_relation: Warm neutrals, Aura Teal water accents

men_domains.principle: Same brand, different expression. Quiet masculine luxury throughout.

BEARD.subject: Beard texture, grooming ritual, oil application, shaping
BEARD.lighting: Structured side light for texture. Warm.

SHAVE.subject: Lather, blade, skin prep, post-shave
SHAVE.composition: Sequential or hero moment. Clean background.

HAIR.subject: Cut, texture, scalp, styling
HAIR.lighting: Top light for volume. Rim for separation.
HAIR.composition: Barber chair environmental or clean studio.

lighting.key_light: Large diffuse source (octabox, large softbox, window). Women: 45 deg/large. Men: slightly smaller/harder for structure. Distance: 2-3m.
lighting.fill: Warm reflector (gold/silver white) or large bounce. Ratio: Women 1:2, Men 1:3 (more structure). Temperature: 5000K-5600K.
lighting.contrast: Soft premium depth. Not flat, not hard commercial. Women: lower contrast. Men: higher contrast but graduated.
lighting.temperature: Women: 5200K-5600K (warmer). Men: 5000K-5400K (neutral-warm). AURA: 5600K + Teal accent gels for abstract.
lighting.shadow: Graduated, soft edges. No hard shadow lines. Fill lifts shadows to visible detail.
lighting.highlight: Controlled. Skin: natural specular. Hair: separation rim. Beard: oil sheen. Product: intentional catchlight.
lighting.skin_rendering: Natural texture at 100% zoom. Pores, fine hair, micro-texture visible. No frequency separation over-smoothing.
lighting.practicals: Candlelight, tungsten lamps, golden hour sun, warm LED strips - for environmental warmth.

types.LIGHT: Cream (#FAF8F5), Warm White (#F2EFEA), Sand (#D0C9B1). Use: Women hero, product clean, onboarding light.
types.WARM_NEUTRAL: Taupe (#5C5348 lightened), Warm Stone (#3A342E lightened), Light Graphite. Use: Men hero, editorial, environmental.
types.DARK_NEUTRAL: Graphite (#1C1F23), Obsidian (#0F1114) - ONLY contextual, not brand default. Use: Men low-key, fragrance, AURA abstract.
types.EDITORIAL: Textured walls, fabric, stone, plaster, muted painted surfaces. Warm undertones. Use: Brand campaigns, provider covers.
types.ENVIRONMENTAL: Real locations: salon, barbershop, spa, lounge, bathroom. Styled, not documentary. Use: Service photography, lifestyle.
types.ABSTRACT: Blurred bokeh, gradient fields, light geometry, organic shapes. Use: AURA, loading states, transitions.

rules: Never solid cream as universal default
Never solid black as brand background
Texture over flat color when possible

SERVICE.purpose: Experience, not object. Hands, interaction, moment

universal_rules: Rule of thirds for subject placement
Text-safe zones designed in, not after
CTA-safe zones (bottom 15%) kept clear in hero
Consistent aspect ratios per component type
No accidental crops: eyes, face, hands, key product

hero_system.subject_placement: Lower third or left/right third. Never center unless symmetrical editorial.
hero_system.negative_space: Minimum 35% frame for headline + subhead + CTA.
hero_system.text_safe_area: Top 40% or side 40% - defined per asset in metadata.
hero_system.cta_safe_area: Bottom 15% kept visually quiet (no high-contrast detail).
hero_system.crop: 9:16 mobile, 16:9 desktop. Same asset, responsive crop.
hero_system.mobile_behavior: Center-crop to 9:16. Text reflows to overlay zones.
hero_system.desktop_behavior: Full 16:9 or wider. Text in side negative space.

card_system.aspect_ratio: 4:5 primary (service cards, provider cards). 1:1 secondary (product grid, square thumbnails). 16:9 tertiary (wide service banners).
card_system.crop: Consistent per card type. Center-weighted. Subject never touches edge.
card_system.image_treatment: Full bleed to radius. No internal padding.
card_system.overlay: Gradient scrim bottom 40% (S1 scrimBottom) for text legibility. Opacity: 0.4-0.6.
card_system.text_relationship: Service name + category over image. Price/badge in corner. Never over subject face.

approach: Client receiving - relaxed, eyes closed, peaceful
Environment as character - light, texture, atmosphere
Before/during/after only if authentic, not staged

categories.beauty_service: Facial, nails, makeup, hair - ritual focus
categories.grooming: Beard, shave, hair, scalp - precision focus

styles.product_isolation: Clean, shadowless or subtle drop shadow. Warm neutral background. For Store grid, PDP hero.
styles.contextual_product: In use: hand holding, on vanity, in bag. Lifestyle but controlled.
styles.hands: Model hands (official muse) interacting. Clean nails, natural.
styles.lifestyle: Environmental: bathroom shelf, gym bag, travel kit. Styled, not candid.
styles.shelf: Boutique shelf arrangement. Multiple products. Editorial.
styles.boutique: Display context: tester, packaging, brand environment.

product_photography.coexistence_with_store: Store uses isolation (1:1, 4:5). Lifestyle/contextual for hero banners, editorial sections, cross-sell.
product_photography.technical: Color accurate (S1 palette). No color cast. Consistent lighting across SKU set.

retouching.policy: NO plastic skin. NO unrealistic perfection. NO aggressive smoothing. NO distorted facial features. MUST conserve human texture.
retouching.skin_texture_standard: Visible at 100%: pores, fine vellus hair, micro-wrinkles, natural sheen variation.

color_grading.authority: S1 COLOR SYSTEM is chromatic authority. Photography respects it, does not create parallel colors.
color_grading.women_palette: Rose Gold (#D4AF7A), Champagne (#D9A27F), Warm Brown (#5A3A2A), Cream (#FAF8F5)
color_grading.men_palette: Champagne (#C8B08A), Warm White (#F2EFEA), Copper (#B8734A), Warm Stone (#3A342E), Taupe (#5C5348)
rules: No excessive color grading / permanent filters
Brand color COMPLEMENTS photography, does not replace it
Skin tones rendered faithfully - warm, healthy
White balance: slightly warm (5800K-6200K) for brand warmth
Split toning: warm highlights, neutral-cool shadows (subtle)
AURA Teal only in AURA contexts - not global grade

materials.skin: Primary texture. Natural, varied by area (face vs hand vs body).
materials.fabric: Silk, linen, cashmere, wool, cotton. Drape, weave visible.
materials.metal: Product packaging: brushed, matte, chrome. Warm reflections.

rules: Texture serves sensory communication, not decoration
Product texture must be accurate to material
Skin texture ALWAYS natural (see retouching policy)

rules.mobile: 9:16 hero, 4:5 cards, 1:1 thumbnails. Center-weighted. Face/eyes never cut.
universal: Hands: crop at wrist or mid-forearm, never fingers
Product: show full form or intentional detail crop
Brand subject (muse) never displaced by UI

cropping.safe_zones: Defined per asset in metadata: text-safe, CTA-safe, subject-safe.

responsive.strategy: Single asset per composition where possible. Responsive crop via focal point metadata. Specific asset only when crop destroys composition.
responsive.focal_point: Defined per asset (x%, y%). Crop centers on focal point.

permitted: Slow zoom (Ken Burns): 2-5% over 8-12s. Hero only.
Parallax: 2-3% offset on scroll. Subtle depth.
Subtle pan: 1-2% slow drift. Ambient/background only.
motion.principle: Photography is still. Motion serves attention, not decoration.

ai_generated_imagery.priority: Official muse consistency > AI generation. Real photography first.

allowed: Environmental textures (stone, fabric, wood) - no people
Abstract backgrounds (blur, gradient, geometry) - no brand conflict
conditionally_allowed: Lifestyle environments - ONLY if: matches aesthetic, no models, warm neutrals, editorial quality
Service environment - ONLY if: no identifiable people, matches lighting philosophy
prohibited: Generic beauty stock (women laughing with cucumber eyes)
Generic barbershop stock (striped pole, vintage chair)
Any image with visible face not official muse
stock_policy.criteria: Meets aesthetic + no model conflict + not generic + visual continuity.

model_consistency.new_faces: Requires Design Director approval. Justification: new demographic, new service category, campaign-specific. Documented in asset metadata.
model_consistency.continuity: Same muse across all brand surfaces for given expression. Cross-expression: female muse in Women, male muse in Men, both in neutral/brand.

criteria.resolution: Hero: 4000px min long edge. Card: 2000px. Thumbnail: 800px. @3x for density.
criteria.sharpness: Critical focus on eyes (portrait) or primary subject. No motion blur unless intentional.
criteria.skin_detail: Visible texture at 100%. No over-sharpening halos.
criteria.compression: WebP 85% quality. AVIF 50% if supported. No visible artifacts.
criteria.lighting: Per Lighting section. Measured: key/fill ratio, temperature, shadow graduation.
criteria.composition: Per Composition section. Text-safe zones verified.
criteria.artifact_detection: No moire, banding, chromatic aberration, compression artifacts, dust spots.

image_quality.validation: Manual review per asset. Automated: resolution, format, compression check in CI.

accessibility.alt_text: Descriptive, contextual, concise. 'Female muse applying serum, warm morning light' not 'woman putting on cream'.
accessibility.semantic_description: For meaningful images: conveys information (service action, product use, result). For decorative: empty alt or role='presentation'.
accessibility.decorative_images: Background textures, abstract AURA geometry, divider imagery - marked decorative.
accessibility.meaningful_images: Hero, service demonstration, product, muse portraits - full alt text.
accessibility.text_in_images: PROHIBITED. All text in UI layer (S2 Typography). No burned-in text.
accessibility.implementation_status: SPECIFICATION + IMPLEMENTATION REQUIRED. No technical compliance claimed.

governance.who_can_add: Design Director approval required for: new muse, new hero asset, new category style, AI-generated production asset.
governance.model_documentation: Asset metadata: model name, contract, usage rights, expression (Women/Men/Neutral), shoot date, photographer, lighting spec, retouching log.
governance.continuity: Asset registry with versioning. Old versions archived, not deleted. Changelog per asset.
governance.asset_metadata: EXIF + custom XMP: expression, category, muse, focal_point, text_safe_zones, cta_safe_zone, color_profile, retouching_level, approval_status, version.
governance.versioning: Semantic: vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Major: new muse/style. Minor: new asset same style. Patch: crop/color correction.
